title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Scrum Master - Fully Remote
description:
Scrum Master – Fully Remote


We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support our software and network development teams. You will be responsible for guiding teams in agile principles and practices, removing obstacles, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies – daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Coach team members in agile practices and Scrum values to ensure consistent application.
  • Foster collaboration between developers, testers, product owners, and stakeholders.
  • Promote transparency and effective communication within and across teams.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination when multiple Scrum teams are working on related products or features.


Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Scrum Master working with software development teams.
  • Strong understanding of Agile frameworks and principles.
  • Must have experience working in Telecommunications.
  • Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and coaching skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to work in a hectic environment.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PSM I/II, or equivalent certification.
  • Familiarity with Scaled Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, LeSS).
  • Background in software development or QA (is a plus).

title: Cypress Test Automation Engineer
description:
Title: Cypress Test Automation Engineer

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Job Description

8+ years as a Test Automation Engineer/SDET, you will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts using tools like Cypress. You will work closely with development teams to design robust, scalable, and efficient test automation frameworks and strategies, ensuring that the products meet the highest standards of quality. Your role will be crucial in building and optimizing automated tests for web applications across various browsers and environments, focusing on continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

Key Responsibilities:

• Test Automation Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive test automation strategies, ensuring thorough coverage of both functional and non-functional testing requirements.

• Automated Test Script Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, and other relevant tools, ensuring compatibility with various browsers and platforms.

• Framework Development: Create and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks, incorporating best practices and design patterns such as Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven, or Keyword-Driven frameworks.

• Continuous Integration: Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI, ensuring automated tests run efficiently in every build and release.

• Test Execution & Reporting: Execute automated tests in different environments and ensure they are executed with the correct data sets, logging, and reporting outcomes. Analyze test results and provide actionable insights.

• Collaboration: Work closely with QA, DevOps, and Development teams to ensure seamless integration of test automation processes into the development lifecycle.

• Bug Reporting & Tracking: Identify and report issues and bugs in the system, assisting development teams in reproducing and debugging issues.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Experience: hands-on experience in test automation with Selenium and Cypress , with a proven track record of successfully automating complex web applications.

• Selenium Expertise: Strong expertise in Selenium WebDriver for automating functional tests, including experience with various browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) and frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, etc.).

• Cypress Expertise : Proficiency in writing and maintaining tests using Cypress, including handling different testing needs like end-to-end, integration, and performance testing.

• Test Automation Frameworks: Hands-on experience in developing and maintaining test automation frameworks using patterns like Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven Testing, and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).

• Programming Languages: Strong coding skills in languages like Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.

• Version Control: Proficient in using Git for source control and managing automation repositories.

• Test Case Design & Reporting: Experience designing detailed test cases, test scripts, and generating clear and actionable test reports.

• Cross-Browser Testing: Experience with cross-browser testing and cross-platform compatibility in automated tests.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Title: Salesforce Developer (4856)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 6+ Months Contract


Pay: BRL 150-160/hr.


Position Summary

The role of the Salesforce Developer is to create new functionality using declarative (e.g. Formula Fields, Process Builder, Flow) or programmatic (e.g. Apex, Visualforce) methods to meet business requirements. The position has the responsibility for researching solutions, troubleshooting bugs, and enhancing the capabilities of Salesforce within best practices guidelines. In addition to understanding technical aspects of Salesforce such as Integration APIs and data security architecture, the role requires analytical problem solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to set push back against unreasonable expectations.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Drive the creation of application and technical design documents which leverage Salesforce best practices
  • Solve complex issues using troubleshooting methodologies combined with expert knowledge of Salesforce applications.
  • Work closely with Business Analysts using Agile development techniques to understand requirements and build high quality solutions
  • Develop application fixes for critical issues with declarative (Workflows, Approvals, Formulas, etc…) and programmatic tools (Apex Classes, Triggers, Visualforce, Lightning, etc…)
  • Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners
  • Proactively research, present and make recommendations regarding new features made available with each Salesforce release.
  • Perform review of code in collaboration with Administrators, to ensure long term viability & integrity.
  • Make recommendations for enhancements and modifications to improve system performance, efficiency and reporting.
  • Collaborate with team members in a virtual team environment to extend field experience to different geographies.
  • Contribute to the development and management of knowledge-sharing methodologies, diagnostic tools, and creative processes, to improve the end user experience.
  • Be a pro-active contributor to a 24x7x365 running support organization, this will require working flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays and monitoring email regularly outside standard business hours.


Additional Duties & Responsibilities

  • Review technical solutions and documentation developed by other team members
  • Mentor and cross train other team members


Minimal Qualifications

  • Platform Developer I Certification
  • Platform Developer II Certification
  • Platform App Builder Certification
  • Experience in Lightning Web Components


Education

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience


Experience

  • Minimum combined 10 years development experience with CRM applications with 4+ years of hands-on development with Salesforce
  • 4+ years of development in medium to large complexity Salesforce Orgs
  • Deep expertise of Salesforce architecture, administration, best practices, and CRM business concepts.
  • Experience with post-production managed services and support


Skills

  • Hands on Development with Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and communication skills – verbal & written. Ability to communicate at business level with stakeholders and technical level with developers.
  • Practical knowledge of APIs to integrate Salesforce with other data sources.
  • Expertise in customization of Mobile App.
  • Superb trouble-shooting skills and tenacity in problem solving.
  • Strong knowledge of key application functionality, data security, and relationships.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally in high pressure situations.
  • The ability to work effectively from a home-based office in a virtual environment.


Desired Qualifications

  • Integration Architecture Designer Certification
  • Certified Sharing and Visibility Designer
  • A consulting background, while not mandatory, would be useful
  • 2+ Years of Experience in DevOps Environment

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Title: Salesforce Developer (4856)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 6+ Months Contract


Pay: BRL 150-160/hr.


Position Summary

The role of the Salesforce Developer is to create new functionality using declarative (e.g. Formula Fields, Process Builder, Flow) or programmatic (e.g. Apex, Visualforce) methods to meet business requirements. The position has the responsibility for researching solutions, troubleshooting bugs, and enhancing the capabilities of Salesforce within best practices guidelines. In addition to understanding technical aspects of Salesforce such as Integration APIs and data security architecture, the role requires analytical problem solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to set push back against unreasonable expectations.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Drive the creation of application and technical design documents which leverage Salesforce best practices
  • Solve complex issues using troubleshooting methodologies combined with expert knowledge of Salesforce applications.
  • Work closely with Business Analysts using Agile development techniques to understand requirements and build high quality solutions
  • Develop application fixes for critical issues with declarative (Workflows, Approvals, Formulas, etc…) and programmatic tools (Apex Classes, Triggers, Visualforce, Lightning, etc…)
  • Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners
  • Proactively research, present and make recommendations regarding new features made available with each Salesforce release.
  • Perform review of code in collaboration with Administrators, to ensure long term viability & integrity.
  • Make recommendations for enhancements and modifications to improve system performance, efficiency and reporting.
  • Collaborate with team members in a virtual team environment to extend field experience to different geographies.
  • Contribute to the development and management of knowledge-sharing methodologies, diagnostic tools, and creative processes, to improve the end user experience.
  • Be a pro-active contributor to a 24x7x365 running support organization, this will require working flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays and monitoring email regularly outside standard business hours.


Additional Duties & Responsibilities

  • Review technical solutions and documentation developed by other team members
  • Mentor and cross train other team members

  • Platform Developer I Certification

title: Risk & Governance Analyst - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Risk & Governance Analyst position involves establishing and overseeing the IT governance framework to mitigate operational risks and ensure regulatory compliance, providing strategic metrics that facilitate informed decision-making by senior management. As the strategic architect behind technology's safety and compliance, your mission is to bridge the gap between complex technical operations and business objectives by identifying potential threats before they materialize. You'll build a culture of risk awareness, ensuring IT infrastructure remains resilient, compliant, and aligned with international standards like ISO 27001 and COBIT.


Key responsibilities


- Coordinating information security risk assessment and reassessment activities.

- Following up with risk owners and business areas to obtain status updates and evidence.

- Consolidating, measuring, and communicating monthly KPIs for IT teams.

- Ensuring that periodic reviews include open, in-progress, and closed risks.

- Supporting risk reporting and governance communication to management.


Requirements


- Risk Analysis: 2+ years of professional experience in risk analysis.

- ISO Knowledge: Foundation knowledge of ISO 31000.

- Analytical Background: Background in risk and data analysis.

- Office Suite: Proficiency in Google Office or Microsoft Office.

- Operating Systems: Experience with Windows 10 or superior.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Node/React Fullstack Developer | Senior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Procurar sempre criar a melhor experiência de uso para o usuário final, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, designers e stakeholders para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas complexos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções inovadoras;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, de fácil manutenção, utilizando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de revisão de código, atuando tanto como revisor quanto como autor, garantindo a qualidade e a funcionalidade das features desenvolvidas;
  • Acompanhar o comportamento das aplicações em produção usando as principais métricas de saúde e performance disponíveis nas ferramentas de monitoração, buscando insights de melhorias e entendendo anomalias a partir dessas métricas;
  • Atuar no backend que é a interface de consumo dos dados para todos os front-ends, garantindo resiliência e suporte à alta carga de acessos simultâneos;
  • Contribuir com a aplicação responsável pela entrega do site web do produto, utilizando o ambiente como campo de experimentação e aprendizado sobre o comportamento dos usuários.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Conhecimentos sólidos de NodeJS e React
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de HTML e CSS;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos do sistema de controle de versão Git;
  • Visão sobre design patterns (Criacionais, Estruturais e Comportamentais);
  • Domínio de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (DRY, KISS, TDA, SoC, SOLID);
  • Experiência com testes unitários em JavaScript;
  • Domínio de design de APIs REST (preferencialmente com o framework Express);
  • Visão do modelo arquitetural de micro-serviços;
  • Experiência com design responsivo (media queries, propriedades relativas, flexbox, CSS grid);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de JavaScript e domínio dos paradigmas orientado a objetos e funcional da linguagem;
  • Conhecimento sobre GraphQL (preferencialmente com o framework Apollo);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoração (métricas de performance e erros);
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de hint/lint (preferencialmente ESLint).

description:
**NECESSÁRIO INGLÊS FLUENTE PARA ATENDER TELEFONE**


Esta é uma vaga remota para atuar como Analista de Pré-Vendas na Central de Atendimento da The Minds, uma agência de marketing focada em empresários brasileiros nos EUA. A função consiste em atender leads em inglês , fazer a qualificação inicial e agendar visitas técnicas ou comerciais para os clientes da agência, que são donos de pequenos negócios locais nos Estados Unidos.


FAIXA SALARIAL: De R$ 2.000 a R$ 3.750 entre remuneração fixa e variável.


✏️O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

Você será responsável por recepcionar e qualificar leads gerados para nossos clientes — todos empresários brasileiros com negócios locais nos Estados Unidos.

Sua missão será:

  • Atender leads em INGLÊS por telefone, SMS, e-mail ou plataformas digitais;

title: Desenvolvedor de mainframe
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade


Sobre a oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar em um projeto relevante de adequação de CNPJ ao formato alfanumérico , com forte atuação em ambiente DB2 e COBOL .


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar alterações em tabelas DB2 para adequação do CNPJ ao formato alfanumérico
  • Analisar e ajustar programas Cobol impactados pela mudança

  • Desenvolver e ajustar rotinas e procedimentos em SQL / Proc SQL
  • Apoiar testes, validações e acompanhamento de implantações

title: Young Professional – IT Recruiter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Young Professional – IT Recruiter position focuses on launching your career in talent acquisition within a global tech company. This role involves supporting end-to-end recruitment processes and developing sourcing and interviewing skills alongside experienced recruiters. You'll participate in the full recruitment cycle from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination while building talent pipelines and collaborating with hiring teams.


Key responsibilities


- Supporting the full recruitment cycle, from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination.

- Sourcing candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, and other platforms to build a strong talent pipeline.

- Reviewing resumes and conducting initial screening calls to assess candidate profiles and interest.

- Coordinating interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth experience for all parties.

- Maintaining and updating candidate records in the ATS, keeping data accurate and up to date.

- Collaborating with senior recruiters and hiring teams to understand role requirements and refine search strategies.


Requirements


- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field — or currently pursuing one.

- Career Interest: Strong interest in IT recruitment and talent acquisition.

- Professional Attitude: Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Core Skills: Good communication and interpersonal skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. title: SAP PP Consultant
description:
SAP PP Consultant


***Anexar currículo somente em Inglês***


Responsabilidades:

SAP (PP, PI e QM):

  • Atuar como especialista nos módulos SAP PP (Production Planning), PI (Process Integration) e QM (Quality Management) , com experiência relevante.
  • Participar de pelo menos 2 ciclos completos de implementação SAP (end-to-end) utilizando a metodologia ASAP.
  • Realizar configurações completas e independentes dos módulos PP e QM.
  • Garantir a integração entre módulos SAP , especialmente com SD, MM e FI.
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas técnicas como LSMW, BDC, BAPI, BADI, Enhancements e User Exits .

Gerenciar e configurar:

  • Dados mestres (Master Data)
  • MRP, MPS
  • Planejamento e nivelamento de capacidade
  • Integração com sistemas MES
  • Processos de manufatura discreta, repetitiva e de processo
  • Configuração de variantes
  • Batch Management e Serial Profile
  • Shop Floor Control
  • Process Order Management
  • Material Staging e Subcontratação
  • Atuar no módulo QM nos processos de:
  • Compras, Produção e Logística
  • Configuração de dados mestres de QM
  • Inspeção (Skip Lot, Source Inspection, Inspection Points)
  • Regras de modificação dinâmica
  • Emissão de certificados de qualidade (COA)
  • Integrar sistemas SAP com sistemas não-SAP .



Requisitos / Qualificações:

  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).
  • Experiência sólida nos módulos SAP PP, PI e QM.
  • Vivência comprovada em implementações completas SAP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em integração de sistemas SAP e não-SAP.
  • Experiência com ferramentas técnicas SAP (LSMW, BDC, BAPI, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em GIS e ferramentas de geoprocessamento .
  • Capacidade analítica e orientação a soluções.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com clientes.

title: Talent Acquisition Associate - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Associate to join our HR team. This professional will be responsible for identifying and assessing the different profiles (Technical and Non-technical) required by the company and its clients. We are looking for proactive, dynamic people and team players, with great organizational capacity, accustomed to handling multiple tasks, and with marked attention to detail. It is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Review online information of candidates to assess their general fit.

- Contact candidates through phone calls, Skype, LinkedIn, or mail to validate their interest and motivate them to participate in our process.

- Schedule internal interviews, send the invites, and keep the system records updated.

- Interview candidates to assess their qualifications by validating their profile, experience, interests, commitment, and logic and common sense questions.

- Schedule and confirm technical interviews.

- Follow up with the candidates throughout the process.

- Adapt to a fast-paced and constantly changing environment.


Requirements:


- 3+ previous years of work experience. Previous experience in recruiting roles is a plus.

- Good communication skills, especially in listening and persuasion.

- Time management and organization.

- Flexibility and adaptability to constant changes.

- Working experience in online and phone sales techniques (is a plus).

- Knowledge in IT Industry head-hunting (is a plus).

- Advanced English Level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Java backend development experience
  • Solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, systems thinking)
  • Experience building and maintaining REST APIs or backend services
  • Comfort working with relational databases
  • Familiarity with HTTP, authentication, and web architecture


Nice to Have

  • PostgreSQL
  • Python development experience
  • Experience with Apache Tomcat or Java Servlets
  • Frontend exposure (TypeScript, Vue, or similar)
  • CI/CD pipeline experience


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: Gerente de QA
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de agronegócio, com foco em tecnologia, transformação digital e sistemas corporativos.


Test Manager


Experience Requirement

5–10 years of demonstrated experience leading complex testing initiatives across enterprise-scale systems.


Role Overview

The Test Manager is responsible for driving consistent, high-quality testing practices across multiple projects. The role ensures a unified governance model, aligned methodologies, and predictable delivery outcomes.

This position owns end-to-end testing oversight, including strategy execution, resource management, stakeholder coordination, risk management, and progress reporting. The Test Manager plans, controls, and continuously improves testing activities to ensure that software and integrated systems meet defined quality standards prior to release. This includes defining quality objectives, supporting test automation where appropriate, and ensuring teams clearly understand testing processes, controls, and governance expectations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Define, communicate, and enforce the overall test strategy across all stakeholders and delivery teams.
  • Identify, secure, and coordinate testing resources aligned to scope and delivery milestones.
  • Ensure test environments, data, and system integrations are available and fit for purpose.
  • Review and manage defects, risks, and issues arising from all testing phases.
  • Establish and maintain a centralized test scenario and test asset repository.
  • Identify and reuse existing test materials to improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Collaboratively agree and finalize test scope with all impacted areas.
  • Define, prepare, and validate test data requirements in line with agreed scope.
  • Develop detailed daily test execution plans, including contingency and lower-priority scenarios.
  • Define and gain agreement on clear exit criteria to the testing cycles.
  • Identify and manage the regression testing scope to protect existing functionality.



Core Skills & Competencies


  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in software testing and quality assurance within enterprise environments.
  • Proven ability to lead, coordinate, and motivate testing teams across multiple workstreams.
  • Strong background in test planning, scoping, estimation, and test analysis.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills across business and technical teams.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated expertise in defining, implementing, and governing test strategies and test plans.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC models and a wide range of testing methodologies.
  • Practical knowledge of test automation tools, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Desirable Skills & Experience Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA and Salesforce Lightning Platforms, including modules, applications, and delivery approaches.
  • Technical background with an understanding of system integrations and interface protocols.
  • Experience planning and executing performance, load, and stress testing.
  • Strong exposure to Agile delivery models and cross-functional team collaboration.
  • Business analysis capabilities, including requirements elicitation and validation techniques
  • TDD (Test Driven Development) proven experience.
  • Jira XRay, Selenium and Tricentis TTA proven experience


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

Experience Requirement

5–10 years of demonstrated experience leading complex testing initiatives across enterprise-scale systems.


Role Overview

The Test Manager is responsible for driving consistent, high-quality testing practices across multiple projects. The role ensures a unified governance model, aligned methodologies, and predictable delivery outcomes.

This position owns end-to-end testing oversight, including strategy execution, resource management, stakeholder coordination, risk management, and progress reporting. The Test Manager plans, controls, and continuously improves testing activities to ensure that software and integrated systems meet defined quality standards prior to release. This includes defining quality objectives, supporting test automation where appropriate, and ensuring teams clearly understand testing processes, controls, and governance expectations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Define, communicate, and enforce the overall test strategy across all stakeholders and delivery teams.
  • Identify, secure, and coordinate testing resources aligned to scope and delivery milestones.

  • Review and manage defects, risks, and issues arising from all testing phases.
  • Establish and maintain a centralized test scenario and test asset repository.
  • Identify and reuse existing test materials to improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Collaboratively agree and finalize test scope with all impacted areas.
  • Define, prepare, and validate test data requirements in line with agreed scope.
  • Develop detailed daily test execution plans, including contingency and lower-priority scenarios.
  • Define and gain agreement on clear exit criteria to the testing cycles.
  • Identify and manage the regression testing scope to protect existing functionality.



Core Skills & Competencies


  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in software testing and quality assurance within enterprise environments.
  • Proven ability to lead, coordinate, and motivate testing teams across multiple workstreams.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills across business and technical teams.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated expertise in defining, implementing, and governing test strategies and test plans.

  • TDD (Test Driven Development) proven experience.

- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

title: Scrum Master - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Scrum Master - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em times ágeis de desenvolvimento, testes, suporte, infraestrutura e manutenção, com atuação em ágil convencional e ágil escalado.
  • Domínio de Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, métricas ágeis e CI/CD.
  • Capacidade de facilitar cerimônias, orientar times, remover impedimentos, promover padrões ágeis e utilizar indicadores para garantir a qualidade, apoiar ações estratégicas e induzir a evolução e a melhoria contínua.
  • Certificações ágeis são desejáveis.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Email Marketing & Deliverability Specialist (iGaming / Crypto / Forex)
description:
About the Role

Inferno Partners is a fast growing iGaming acquisition network operating across multiple international markets.


We are looking for a hybrid Email Marketing & Deliverability Specialist who can manage both:

  • Email campaign execution (performance & targeting)
  • Mailing infrastructure (SMTP, domains, deliverability)


This is not a pure CRM role .

Candidates must have hands-on experience with email infrastructure and high-volume sending systems .


What You’ll Do

Email Campaign Management

  • Create and manage email campaigns (acquisition, retention, reactivation)
  • Segment databases and optimize targeting
  • Monitor KPIs: open rate, CTR, conversion
  • Run A/B tests and improve campaign performance

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Front-end Angular Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de profissionais que querem elevar o patamar do desenvolvimento front-end através da inteligência artificial. Se você domina Angular e acredita que a IA é uma aliada poderosa para entregar código de alta qualidade com mais agilidade, essa oportunidade é para você. Você fará parte de um time global focado na construção de uma plataforma financeira complexa, utilizando stack de última geração e fluxos de trabalho aumentados por IA.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver telas responsivas em Angular com base em requisitos e design fornecidos pela equipe;
  • Integrar componentes de UI com APIs RESTful e serviços já existentes;
  • Utilizar ferramentas e pipelines de IA para geração e refinamento de código;
  • Revisar, validar e aprimorar o código gerado por IA antes da integração final;
  • Colaborar com Product Owners, designers, desenvolvedores backend e QA;
  • Criar testes unitários e testes de integração para componentes de interface;
  • Participar de code reviews, planning, cerimônias Scrum e demais rituais do time;
  • Investigar, analisar e corrigir bugs e problemas relacionados à UI.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 3+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento front-end/UI;
  • Forte domínio de Angular e TypeScript;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Graduação ou pós-graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com aplicações web responsivas e baseadas em componentes;
  • Bom conhecimento de HTML5, CSS3/SCSS e ferramentas modernas de build front-end;
  • Experiência integrando front-end com APIs REST;
  • Entendimento de princípios modernos de engenharia de software;
  • Experiência com Git e fluxos de branch/merge;
  • Vivência com testes automatizados, como Cypress, Pact ou Jest;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente dentro de um time estruturado;
  • Boa comunicação e postura colaborativa.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistidas por IA, como Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em domínio financeiro/ERP, como contabilidade geral, folha de pagamento, RH, gestão de materiais, contabilidade patrimonial, compras;
  • Experiência com RxJS e padrões reativos;
  • Vivência com ferramentas Atlassian: Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket;
  • Familiaridade com Kubernetes, microserviços e desenvolvimento orientado a containers;
  • Experiência com AWS;
  • Vivência em ambientes Ágeis/Scrum.


Modelo de Trabalho:

  • PJ ou Cooperado;
  • 100% Remoto;
  • Necessária disponibilidade para atuar em horário administrativo no fuso horário Central Time (CT).


Eleve sua carreira para o nível internacional. Candidate-se!

title: Diretor comercial
description:
Vaga – Diretor Comercial | Inglês Fluente

Você lidera vendas… ou constrói crescimento real?

O mercado está cheio de gestores comerciais.

Poucos sabem orquestrar múltiplas tecnologias, escalar receita e formar times que entregam de verdade .

Na Revna, liderança comercial não é sobre controle.

É sobre direcionar, acelerar e transformar resultado em padrão .


Sua missão

Liderar a estratégia comercial da Revna, gerenciando verticais de negócio e múltiplas tecnologias (Oracle, SAP, TOTVS e multi-tech) , garantindo crescimento sustentável, previsibilidade de receita e excelência na execução.

title: Professor(a) de inglês | Aulas online (PJ)
description:
Estamos em busca de professoras de inglês para atuação em parceria com o Inglês Empoderado, escola de ensino online focada em conversação para alunos adultos.


A atuação será realizada como prestadora de serviços (modelo PJ) , com foco na condução de aulas ao vivo e acompanhamento do desenvolvimento das alunas.


Formato de Atuação:

• Prestação de serviços educacionais (modelo PJ)

• Aulas 100% online (Google Meet)

• Atuação com alunos adultos (níveis iniciante ao intermediário)

• Utilização de material de apoio disponibilizado pela escola

• Remuneração por hora/aula


Modelo de Parceria:

A atuação não configura vínculo empregatício, sendo realizada de forma autônoma , com liberdade de organização da agenda. Trata-se de prestação de serviços sem exclusividade , podendo a profissional atuar com outras instituições.


Buscamos parceiras que:

• Tenham experiência com aulas online

• Conduzam aulas com foco em conversação

• Tenham boa comunicação e didática com adultos

• Sejam organizadas e comprometidas com a experiência da aluna

• Tenham familiaridade com ferramentas digitais (Google Meet, Docs, etc.)


Se você se identifica com esse modelo e busca atuar de forma flexível em um ambiente leve, organizado e focado no desenvolvimento real dos alunos, será um prazer te conhecer!


Envie seu currículo para:

title: Analista de cobrança
description:
Descrição da vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Cobrança para integrar nosso time!

O profissional será responsável por atuar na cobrança de forma estratégica e negocial, acompanhando carteiras, conduzindo tratativas com firmeza e identificando oportunidades ao longo do processo.

Buscamos alguém com assertividade, constância e postura profissional, que saiba sustentar limites, acompanhar cada caso com critério e atuar com responsabilidade na recuperação de valores.


Principais responsabilidades

• Acompanhar a carteira de clientes e títulos em aberto, garantindo rotina de cobrança e follow-up contínuo;

• Realizar contatos de cobrança com postura profissional, firmeza e clareza na condução das tratativas;

• Atuar em negociações e acordos de pagamento, buscando soluções viáveis sem perder o critério necessário;

• Monitorar vencimentos, inadimplência e andamento das negociações;

• Registrar informações, histórico das tratativas e encaminhamentos de forma organizada;

• Apoiar a identificação de oportunidades e sinais relevantes ao longo do acompanhamento da carteira;

• Contribuir com a equipe no fortalecimento dos processos e controles da área.


Competências necessárias

• Desejável experiência prévia com cobrança, negociação ou rotinas financeiras;

• Vivência com acompanhamento de carteira, títulos vencidos e inadimplência;

• Boa organização para controle de demandas, registros e prazos;

• Capacidade de análise para avaliar contexto, histórico e melhor condução dos casos;

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

• Comprometimento com qualidade, constância e resultados.


Diferenciais

• Vivência em instituições financeiras, FIDC, securitizadoras ou fintechs;

• Experiência com cobrança empresarial e negociações B2B;

• Conhecimento em sistemas, planilhas e ferramentas de controle da área;

• Perfil com boa leitura negocial e atenção a oportunidades identificadas no processo.


Venha fazer parte da Banfita e contribuir para uma atuação cada vez mais estratégica e consistente na gestão da carteira!

title: Cientista De Desenvolvimento De Produtos Iii
description:

  • Executar atividades de desenvolvimento de produtos e processos de média a alta complexidade, desde a concepção até a comercialização;
  • Identificar comprecisão os requisitos do projeto, aplicando a capacidade de produção, os ingredientes, a formulação e o design adequados para atender às necessidades dos clientes, às especificações do produto e às metas financeiras;
  • Realizar avaliações sensoriais internas, aplicações de produtos e testes de validade para determinar a aceitabilidade de protótipos e produtos competitivos para clientes e consumidores;
  • Seguir as diretrizes e protocolos estabelecidos, abordagem científica e análise estatística no desenvolvimento de produtos, testes em fábricas, inicialização de fábricas, estudos sensoriais, estudos de estabilidade de validade, estudos de capacidade e desenvolvimento de especificações;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico para resolver problemas de média á alta complexidade relacionadas à produção e qualidade, identificando a causa raiz, desenvolvendo e implementando soluções, incluindo treinamento de pessoal de controle de qualidade/operações sobre as conclusões dentro da categoria de produto atribuída;
  • Apoiar um ambiente que promova a inovação, introduzindo continuamente ideias e conceitos de produtos para novos produtos, melhorias de qualidade e produtividade e facilitar a tomada de riscos calculados;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação da estratégia de matérias-primas em colaboração com o grupo da cadeia de abastecimento e fornecedores externos para obter um desempenho diferenciado dos novos produtos e qualidade ou redução de custos;
  • Desenvolver umaestratégia de matérias-primas em colaboração com o grupo da cadeia de abastecimento e fornecedores externos para obter um desempenho diferenciado dos novos produtos e qualidade;
  • Fornecer avaliações/perspectivas de risco técnico e comercial relacionadas com o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e atividades técnicas de gestão da marca;
  • Liderar, treinar e orientar técnicos;
  • Fornecer aconselhamento técnico a outros dentro da especialidade;


Experiências Anteriores:


  • Experiência comprovada na aplicação de normas técnicas, princípios, teorias, conceitos e interpretação de dados através de projetos experimentais sólidos e análises estatísticas (experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos e/ou processos alimentares, desde a concepção até a comercialização);
  • Sólido conhecimento em informática (Excel, Word, bancos de dados, software estatístico) e capacidade de criar planilhas, análises computacionais e relatórios;

  • Mestrado e/ou Doutorado em Ciência Alimentar, Química/Alimentar/Biológica ou áreas relacionadas;

  • Foco em alcançar os objetivos do projeto e entregar resultados significativos;
  • Manter a responsabilidade pelos prazos e padrões de qualidade;
  • Adaptabilidade e resiliência: Confortável em lidar com ambiguidades, mudanças, prioridades e incertezas;
  • Lidar com riscos e desafios inesperados com serenidade e mentalidade voltada para a resolução de problemas;
  • Pensamento inovador: introduz continuamente novas ideias e conceitos para melhorias e inovação de produtos;
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe: trabalha de forma eficaz em ambientes multifuncionais;
  • Estabelecer relações sólidas com equipes internas e parceiros externos (fornecedores, instituições);

  • Orientação parao cliente e os negócios: Compreende as necessidades dos clientes e as traduz em soluções técnicas. Equilibra decisões técnicas com considerações financeiras e comerciais;

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior – Modelo Híbrido


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sr com visão moderna, apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, inovação e pelo uso de Inteligência Artificial no desenvolvimento de soluções.

Se você busca desafios reais, autonomia e a chance de criar produtos que impactam milhares de pessoas, essa vaga é para você!


Atividades e Responsabilidades

Apoio técnico ao Product Manager, essencial execução de demandas de codificação e resolução de bloqueios junto ao time de desenvolvimento.


Principais Responsabilidades:


1. Desenvolvimento e Implementação: Você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar aplicações web de alta qualidade utilizando ReactJS/Vue.Js, .NET e NodeJS. Você deverá garantir que todas as aplicações sejam performáticas, escaláveis e mantidas adequadamente.


2. Construção de Componentes: Você será responsável por criar componentes reutilizáveis e funcionalidades para proporcionar a melhor experiência possível para o usuário. Isso inclui a construção, evolução e escalamento de arquiteturas distribuídas e micro serviços.


3. Code Review: Uma parte significativa de sua função será a participação em revisões de código para garantir a qualidade do código, a aplicação das melhores práticas e a eficiência na resolução de problemas.


4. Melhorias Contínuas: Você deverá propor constantemente melhorias nas soluções existentes para propiciar melhor desempenho, bem como acompanhar as novidades tecnológicas do ecossistema e proativamente sugerir mudanças que podem melhorar o processo de desenvolvimento. Isso pode incluir a adoção de novas ferramentas, técnicas de automação ou melhores práticas.


5. Implementação de CI/CD: Como parte do foco na eficiência e qualidade, você será responsável pela implementação de práticas de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).


6. Testes: O desenvolvimento e aplicação de testes automatizados para garantir a qualidade e a integridade das aplicações serão uma parte fundamental de suas responsabilidades.


Requisitos

1. Experiência prévia comprovada em posição similar.

2. Proficiência em .NET, Vue.Js/ReactJS e NodeJS.

3. Experiência com TypeScript.

4. Experiência com banco de dados relacional e não relacional.

5. Conhecimento com APIs REST.

6. Experiência com ferramentas de testes como Jest e Cypress.

7. Experiência em Docker e conteinerização de aplicações.

8. Experiência com sistemas de versionamento (Git) e pipelines de CI/CD.

9. Experiência com micro serviços e comunicação assíncrona com MQ (Ex: RabbitMQ)

10. Conhecimento em estratégias de cache.

11. Conhecimento em DevOps e plataformas Cloud (Azure).

12. Conhecimento sólido em princípios do desenvolvimento de software, como design patterns, SOLID, e melhores práticas para softwares escaláveis.

13. Experiência em modelagem de domínio com DDD.

14. Excelente comunicação e habilidades de colaboração.

15. Conhecimento dos riscos comuns de segurança (OWASP).

16. Conhecimento em estratégias de monitoramento.


Diferenciais:

Conhecimentos em tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial no ambiente Azure ou GCP serão considerados um grande diferencial.

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter Para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;



Requisitos:

  • Possuir graduação completa;
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
  • Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Assessor De Investimentos
description:

Etapa Inicial Desde o primeiro dia, o profissional já atua como Assessor de Investimentos, inserido em um modelo de formação intenso e educacional.

- Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).


Por que escolher a EQI?

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado

title: Chief Legal Officer
description:
Gold & Aron Conseil is an executive search company. We are recruiting a CLO on behalf of our client.


Our client is a growing Brazilian fintech with strong social impact and evolving from a startup into a disciplined, institutional-grade organization. In order to accelerate growth even more, the firm is seeking a Chief Legal Officer . The Ideal candidate is someone who can lead all legal related initiatives, navigate complex landscapes, build & manage a high performing team, serve as a trusted advisor to the founders and get things done (not as an advisor but as a legal executive-operator).


Responsibilities

  • Manage all legal matters (mostly domestic but some international exposure as well).
  • Build, structure, and lead a high-performing in-house legal team, including: (i) Defining clear scopes between in-house vs. external counsel;
    (ii) Hiring, developing, and, when necessary, upgrading talent;
    (iii) Implementing SLAs, prioritization frameworks, and legal intake processes;
    (iv) Ensuring legal is a force multiplier, not a bottleneck
  • Process Professionalization: Transition the legal department from "startup mode" to a disciplined "financial institution standard".
  • Risk Optimization: Translate legal constraints into business options. Quantify downside, propose alternatives, and recommend paths that maximize long-term enterprise value
  • Regulatory: Manage the process of applying for SCD (Sociedade de Crédito Direto) License, exposure to Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Open Finance, Consumer protection at scale (BACEN + SENACON dynamics), Structuring new financial products under regulatory ambiguity
  • Be ready to contribute to potential capital raise/M&A processes, manage data rooms, oversee due diligence, and negotiate complex term sheets.


Qualifications

  • 15–20 years of experience.
  • Ideal candidate will bring a generalist expertise being able to navigate Brazilian Employment law, Tax basics, Contract law (Brazil & International), Regulatory, M&A.
  • Ideal candidate has a combination of top-tier law firm and in-house
  • Start-up experience (ideally at a Fintech)
  • Proven People Leadership
  • Language: English fluency is a must.
  • Location: São Paulo. (Hybrid work environment)


This role is NOT for:

  • Pure advisory profiles who prefer external counsel to execution
  • Lawyers who have not personally built, hired, and performance-managed teams
  • Professionals uncomfortable making fast risk trade-offs with imperfect information
  • Candidates who need heavy structure before acting
