title: Parts Inventory Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.



About the Role


The Parts Inventory Manager is responsible for managing spare parts and component inventory across multiple Vammo locations. This role ensures accurate stock control for electrical motorcycles, BBoxes, batteries, and related components.


The position leads the inventory team, maintains accurate data in the Warehouse Management System (WMS), and guarantees that physical stock matches system records through regular cycle counts and inventory audits. The role works closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and After-Sales teams to ensure parts availability and operational efficiency.


Key responsibilities include supervising inventory operations, managing stock levels across sites, implementing inventory control processes, and ensuring reliable reporting and traceability of all parts movements.


Hard Skills


  • Inventory management and stock control
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  • Cycle counting and physical inventory audits
  • Inventory reconciliation and discrepancy analysis
  • Supply chain and logistics processes
  • Data analysis and reporting (Excel / ERP / dashboards)
  • Multi-site inventory management
  • Demand planning and stock level optimization
  • Process implementation and standardization
  • Cost optimization in inventory and logistics
  • Experience with motorcycle components and electronic parts.

  • Communication skills

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

O Gerente de Estoque é responsável por gerenciar o estoque de peças e componentes em diferentes locais da Vammo. Essa função garante o controle preciso do estoque de motocicletas elétricas, BBoxes, baterias e seus respectivos componentes.


A posição lidera o time de inventário, mantém informações precisas no WMS (Warehouse Management System) e garante que o estoque físico esteja alinhado com os registros do sistema por meio de contagens cíclicas e auditorias de inventário. Essa função trabalha em conjunto com as áreas de Supply Chain, Procurement, Operações e Pós-Vendas para garantir disponibilidade de peças e eficiência operacional.


As principais responsabilidades incluem supervisionar as operações de inventário, gerenciar níveis de estoque em diferentes sites, implementar processos de controle de estoque e garantir relatórios confiáveis e rastreabilidade de todas as movimentações de peças.

title: Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


In this role you will:

  • We are looking for Project Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.
  • We are seeking an energetic, execution-focused Project Manager to join our Sec OPs or ITSM Modular Platform Teams.
  • The Modular Platform Programme has been established to enhance the Experian developer experience by creating a single entry point into a range of tools and capabilities supplied via Modular Platforms with AI at their core.
  • As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning and executing projects and/or work package(s) that deliver agreed outcomes on time, in scope, on budget and to the required quality, while ensuring stakeholder satisfaction.
  • The role will require cross-functional team working, managing/interacting with third parties whilst exercising robust governance, risk and change control.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Project and Work Package Planning
  • Define objectives, scope and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders
  • Develop detailed project plans, schedules, resource allocations and budgets
  • Establish project governance, reporting structures, and success criteria.

  • Monitor project performance using relevant metrics and KPIs.
  • Conduct project reviews and capture lessons learned.
  • Financial and Resource Management
  • Track project budgets and manage resource utilization.
  • Ensure effective allocation of team members and other project resources.
  • Project and Work Package Documentation and Reporting
  • Maintain accurate documentation including plans, schedules, and reports.


Mandatory Skills

  • Strong project planning and organisational skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Leadership and team coordination skills
  • Risk management and problem-solving capabilities
  • Budget and resource management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Analytical thinking and decision-making skills
  • Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies
  • 5 - 7 years of proven experience as a Project Manager or in a similar role
  • Demonstrable track record of successful delivery within scope, budget and timeline
  • Experience of working on projects delivering technical modular platforms - not essential
  • Familiarity with project management frameworks (e.G., Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid approaches)
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across departments and business units
  • Understanding of project governance, reporting structures and performance metrics
  • Practical experience managing project risks
  • Educated to degree-level or equivalent
  • Professional qualifications and certifications such as:


Certifications:

o Project Management certification (e.G. PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, APM PMQ or equivalent) - desirable

o Agile certification (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) - not essential

title: Vendedor Tecnico Tratamento De Agua E Efluentes

A Procytek é uma empresa brasileira especializada em soluções para tratamento de água e efluentes industriais. Fundada em 1994, a empresa atua no desenvolvimento e fornecimento de tecnologias, produtos químicos e sistemas completos para indústrias que buscam eficiência operacional, conformidade ambiental e sustentabilidade no uso da água.

Com forte atuação em grandes clientes industriais e projetos de alto valor agregado, a Procytek integra engenharia, tecnologia e conhecimento técnico para desenvolver soluções robustas e personalizadas para seus clientes.

Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Vendedor Técnico para atuar no desenvolvimento de negócios no setor industrial, com foco em soluções para tratamento de água e efluentes.

Este profissional será responsável por identificar novas oportunidades de negócios, desenvolver relacionamento com clientes industriais, entender demandas técnicas e comerciais e estruturar propostas de soluções em conjunto com a equipe de engenharia da empresa.

A posição envolve atuação ativa em prospecção de clientes, desenvolvimento de projetos comerciais e acompanhamento de negociações até o fechamento.

Principais responsabilidades:

- Prospectar e desenvolver novos clientes industriais

- Identificar oportunidades para fornecimento de produtos químicos, sistemas e soluções para tratamento de água e efluentes

- Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais a clientes

- Estruturar propostas comerciais e técnicas em conjunto com a equipe interna

- Conduzir negociações comerciais

- Acompanhar projetos e manter relacionamento contínuo com clientes.

Qualificações

- Experiência prévia em vendas técnicas B2B para indústria

- Perfil comercial ativo, com capacidade de prospecção e desenvolvimento de novos negócios

- Facilidade em compreender soluções técnicas e traduzi-las em valor para o cliente

- Boa comunicação e habilidade de negociação

- Disponibilidade para visitas a clientes


Desejável:

-. Graduação em Engenharia (Química, Ambiental, Produção, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas), Química, Engenharia Sanitária ou áreas técnicas relacionadas ao setor industrial.

  • Também serão considerados profissionais com formação técnica ou superior em áreas industriais, desde que possuam experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas B2B.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
ompany Overview:

Anker Innovations is a global leader in charging technology and a developer of consumer electronics and smart devices. We are committed to bringing innovative products to our customers and ensuring the highest standards of quality and service. As we expand our presence in Latam, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Channel Specialist to join our team


Key Responsibilities:

As a Channel Specialist, you will be the cornerstone of our channel expansion and management efforts in Brazil. Your core duties will include:

  • Project Coordination & Lead Management: Take ownership of the regional distributor recruitment project by collecting, organizing, and managing all distributor leads generated by our sales advisors.
  • Distributor Screening & Onboarding: Conduct preliminary screenings of potential distributors based on established criteria, proactively contact and qualify candidates in target regions, and build a structured pipeline. You will collaborate with our headquarters team to finalize the selection of new distributors.
  • Account Management & Growth: Manage and support the ongoing relationship with appointed regional distributors. This includes facilitating orders, managing procurement processes, monitoring sales targets, and ultimately being accountable for the sales performance and revenue growth within your channel.


Qualifications:

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven professional with:

  • Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience in sales, channel management, or key account management.
  • Industry Knowledge: Prior experience in the consumer electronics industry is highly preferred.
  • Cultural Affinity: Experience working with or for a Chinese company is a significant advantage.
  • Personal Attributes: A self-starter with a strong sense of initiative, excellent resilience under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for embracing change and challenges. You must be a quick learner who can rapidly apply new knowledge to your work.


We Offer:

  • A pivotal role in the expansion of a globally recognized and beloved brand.
  • A dynamic, fast-paced, and supportive international work environment.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • Supervisionar o fluxo de caixa da empresa, garantindo que haja fundos adequados para as operações diárias, bem como para atender a obrigações de pagamento e investimentos
  • Avaliar as necessidades de financiamento da empresa e desenvolver estratégias para garantir acesso a fontes de financiamento adequadas, como empréstimos bancários, emissão de títulos ou outras formas de financiamento.

  • Preparar relatórios financeiros regulares para a alta administração e órgãos reguladores, garantindo conformidade com as normas contábeis e regulamentações financeiras aplicáveis.
  • Identificar oportunidades para melhorar a eficiência dos processos de tesouraria por meio da automação e implementação de sistemas e tecnologias financeiras.
  • Gestão de Pessoas, estruturação de time.
  • Gestão dos pagamentos, bem como dos normativos para garantir os processos bem como a melhora no capital de giro no que tange à PMP
  • Encontrar melhores práticas de como fazer melhor e de forma mais eficiente os processos atuais.

  • Desejável Pós-graduação em Gestão Financeira, Controladoria e Auditoria, Gestão de Negócios, Finanças e afins.

This job requires up to 25% global travel.

title: Engenheiro (A) Mlops E Llmops
description:
Com 70 anos de existência, o Einstein Hospital Israelita ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação em setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como MLOps/LLMOps para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, machine learning tradicional e IA generativa. A pessoa será responsável por projetar, implementar e operar pipelines de ML end-to-end, garantindo que modelos e agentes de IA sejam implantados e monitorados em produção com alta confiabilidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

O papel envolve atuar tanto em MLOps, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de modelos treinados com dados proprietários, quanto em LLMOps, lidando com desafios específicos de LLMs, como versionamento de prompts, variabilidade de outputs, otimização de custos de inferência e monitoramento de alucinaçõe


Informações da vaga:

  • Local de trabalho: Unid Centro de Ens e Pesquisa (AECE)
  • Área: Planejamento Analytics
  • Diretoria : Digital
  • Modelo de trabalho : Híbrido
  • Jornada de trabalho : 220h/mês


Responsabilidades:

MLOps (IA Tradicional)

  • Projetar e manter pipelines CI/CD para treinamento, validacao e deploy de modelos de ML (MLflow,
  • Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines)
  • Implementar IaC para ambientes de ML em cloud (GCP primario), incluindo GPU provisioning e
  • autoscaling
  • Construir e gerenciar feature stores, model registries e pipelines de dados para treinamento
  • Monitoramento de modelos em producao: data drift, concept drift, performance degradation (Evidently,
  • Whylogs, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Garantir reproducibilidade de experimentos com versionamento de dados (DVC, lakeFS) e modelos

LLMOps (IA Generativa & Agentic AI)

  • Operar e otimizar serving de LLMs (vLLM, TGI, Triton) com foco em latencia, throughput e custo
  • Desenvolver pipelines de RAG end-to-end: ingestao, chunking, embedding, vector stores (Pinecone,
  • Weaviate, pgvector, Qdrant)
  • Versionamento de prompts, avaliacao sistematica de saidas (evals) e A/B testing de configuracoes de LLM
  • Gerenciar custo de inferencia: caching inteligente, routing entre modelos, otimizacao de tokens e batching
  • Construir infraestrutura para agentes autonomos (AgentOps): orquestracao, observabilidade, guardrails e
  • circuit breakers
  • Guardrails de seguranca para LLMs: content filtering, PII detection, compliance LGPD/HIPAA

Transversal

  • Governanca, seguranca (RBAC, auditoria) e compliance regulatorio em todo o ciclo de vida
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de software e times de produto
  • Documentar padroes, runbooks e boas praticas para escalar o conhecimento no time


Requisitos

Imprescindíveis:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em MLOps, ML Engineering ou Data/Platform Engineering, com foco em ambientes de produção
  • Solida experiência em implantação de modelos de ML em produção (não apenas em experimentação ou notebooks)
  • Experiência em práticas com workloads de IA generativa (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning ou agentes)
  • Python avançado e proficiência em frameworks de ML (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost)
  • Containers e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (GKE/EKS), Helm
  • Cloud: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Artifact Registry) ou equivalente AWS/Azure
  • IaC: Terraform, Pulumi ou CloudFormation
  • CI/CD para ML: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD
  • Plataformas de ML: MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines ou Metaflow
  • APIs de LLM e frameworks GenAI: OpenAI API, Anthropic API, LangChain, LlamaIndex
  • Git avançado, versionamento de dados (DVC, lakeFS) e versionamento de modelos
  • Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, Evidently AI ou Whylogs

Desejáveis:

  • Experiencia com fine-tuning de LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT) e alinhamento (RLHF/DPO)
  • Serving de modelos em GPU com otimizacao (quantizacao, batching dinamico, vLLM, TensorRT)
  • Pipelines de RAG em producao: embeddings, reranking, vector databases em escala
  • Evals e benchmarks sistematicos para LLMs (ragas, deepeval, promptfoo)
  • Orquestracao de agentes de IA (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen ou similares)
  • Certificacoes cloud (GCP Professional ML Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, Azure AI Engineer)



Einstein Benefícios – Compartilhando Bem-Estar

  • Cuidados com a saúde: Programa Cuidar com serviços realizados no Einstein para promover a saúde e bem-estar dos colaboradores e dependentes, Clínicas Einstein, Telemedicina, Convênio Farmácia, Convênio Médico, Assistência Odontológica e Consultório Dental in Company.
  • Bem-Estar: Wellhub (Gympass), TotalPass, Coral, Programa de Orientação Pessoal e SESC.
  • Para você e sua família: Licença paternidade estendida, Seguro de Vida, Creche ou Auxílio Creche para mães ou pais com guarda legal, Auxílio para Filhos com Deficiência e Previdência Privada com taxa zero.
  • Alimentação: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição ou Refeitório no local de trabalho.
  • Mobilidade: Vale Transporte, Fretado, Estacionamento, Aplicativo de Caronas e Circular Metrô.
  • Clube de Benefícios: Para economizar e obter vantagens nas compras de produtos e serviços de diversas categorias, como Beleza e Fitness, Comer e Beber, Compras, Cultura e Lazer, Educação Ensino Einstein, Turismo e muito mais.
  • Programa Mais Conectados: Trabalho remoto nas modalidades Teletrabalho ou Híbrido conforme atividade e área de atuação.

  • Revisa, analisa e interpreta dados de mercado para identificar tendências emergentes que podem impactar o desempenho da propriedade.


Para nós, a experiência na liderança de equipes comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente é muito importante. Na verdade, procuramos complementar-nos com experiências de outras áreas e organizações, onde o “know-how” pode ser transferível e a multitarefa e a priorização de atividades estão presentes.

title: Technical Solution Engineer - Sao Paulo
description:
About CATL

CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy!

CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years.


Job Description


ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences.


Responsibilities:


  1. Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications
  2. Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities
  3. Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs
  4. Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user’s manual, disposal proposal, etc.,
  5. Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise
  6. Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement
  7. Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed
  8. Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs


Requirements and skills:


  1. Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo
  2. At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market
  3. Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous
  4. Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous
  5. Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous
  6. Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
  7. Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities
  8. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  9. Superb collaboration and communication
  10. Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities
  11. Proficient in English & Portuguese

title: Assistant/Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Assistant/Finance Manager (Coordenador Financeiro) will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Financial Controller (Global HQ).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • 7 - 10 years of experience in finance and tax management within a manufacturing environment, including at least 3 years of experience in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é a maior empresa do Brasil nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais. Sediada no Brasil, atende outros mercados como Angola e Estados Unidos . Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Saneamento

A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Location: Hybrid — Curitiba, Brazil (1–2 days/week on-site)

Type: Contract (PJ)

Salary: $2800 - $3800 (Depending on experience and English fluency)

Schedule: Must be available to work US hours (Mountain Standard Time - MST)


About WAVV

WAVV is an innovative integrated dialer solution designed to enhance the efficiency of modern outbound revenue teams. Our multi-line power dialer seamlessly integrates with CRMs, enabling teams to triple call volumes without fatigue or risking spam flags. Offering features like real-time spam protection, dedicated local numbers for higher answer rates, and unlimited calls, WAVV optimizes outbound communication. Plug-and-play integration ensures effortless adoption, empowering teams to focus on meaningful conversations and closing deals. At WAVV, we believe great conversations drive growth, and our mission is to help teams dial smarter, not harder.


What you’ll do

  • Design and implement OAuth 2.0 authentication flows (auth code, refresh tokens, scopes)
  • Build bi-directional REST API integrations between CRMs and internal systems
  • Ensure data syncing is reliable, queued, retry-safe, and resilient to failures
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, pagination, and API versioning
  • Monitor and debug integration health, edge cases, and data consistency issues
  • Prepare integrations for app store reviews and platform compliance requirements


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend experience (ideally Node.Js or a similar async environment)
  • Deep understanding of REST APIs (designing, consuming, rate limits, authentication flows)
  • Hands-on experience with OAuth 2.0 and token lifecycle management
  • Experience integrating with third-party APIs, including major CRM platforms (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, etc.)
  • Comfortable working with JSON, webhooks, and event-driven systems
  • Experience with async processing and queues (BullMQ, SQS, RabbitMQ, etc.)
  • Solid understanding of retries, idempotency, and data consistency
  • Ability to design and maintain reliable sync pipelines
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills


Nice to have

  • Experience with specific CRM APIs (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)
  • AI tooling familiarity
  • Experience with high-volume data processing
  • DevOps/cloud deployment experience
  • Prior startup experience


What You’ll Get

  • Real ownership over your work and visibility into how it impacts users
  • Collaboration with a sharp team across product, design, and leadership
  • A fast-moving environment where ideas are welcomed and results matter
  • Competitive salary: $2,800 – $3,800 USD/month (PJ contract)
  • Unlimited PTO and true flexibility
  • Team lunches and regular team-building activities


Things to Consider

  • This is a Contract (PJ) position with potential for growth
  • Hybrid role: 1–2 days per week in the Curitiba office, remaining days remote
  • Must have a flexible schedule and be available to work during U.S. hours (MST)
  • Strong written English required
  • Comfortable speaking English in meetings and technical discussions


We’re not hiring just to fill a seat. We’re hiring someone who wants to make a difference, contribute at a high level, and help us scale with quality and clarity. If that sounds like you, let’s talk!


Please make sure to include a copy of your resume in English and to take our quick Culture Survey!

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.


Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Birthday day off.

- Gympass / Totalpass.

description:

Não exigimos experiência prévia ou certificações iniciais. Nosso foco é investir no seu potencial e fornecer as ferramentas necessárias para sua ascensão profissional.


A Trilha de Desenvolvimento do Trainee:

Ingresso e Formação Técnica (ANCORD): Você entra no time com contratação imediata. A Vértua fornece o curso preparatório e todo o suporte necessário para que você obtenha a certificação ANCORD o mais rápido possível, habilitando sua atuação oficial no mercado.



Imersão Comercial (SDR): Com a certificação em mãos, você inicia sua atuação como SDR (Sales Development Representative). Esta fase é focada no desenvolvimento de habilidades de prospecção e relacionamento, aprendendo a dominar a abordagem estratégica e a psicologia do investidor.



Aceleração por Meritocracia: O programa é pautado por resultados. Ao atingir as metas estabelecidas na fase de SDR, você dobra seu salário base, marcando sua prontidão para os próximos níveis de responsabilidade.



Ascensão a Assessor de Investimentos: Após o sucesso comercial inicial, você assume sua própria carteira de clientes, atuando na gestão patrimonial e no atendimento direto a investidores.



Liderança e Partnership (Sociedade): Profissionais que demonstram excelência na entrega e capacidade de gestão ascendem à liderança de times. Na Vértua, o resultado entregue desde o primeiro dia como assessor é o critério para o ingresso no plano de sociedade, permitindo que você se torne sócio do negócio.



Requisitos do Programa:

Paixão pelo Mercado Financeiro: Este é o nosso único requisito essencial. Você não precisa saber o que é um "CDB" hoje, mas deve ter um interesse real em aprender e dominar o assunto.



Gosto em Aprender: O dia a dia da profissão exige conversar com pessoas constantemente. É fundamental estar aberto e disposto para construir relacionamentos profissionais, entender as dificuldades e absorver experiências.



Perfil Ambicioso: Buscamos pessoas que não se acomodam com o fixo e desejam o crescimento acelerado que apenas o ganho variável e a sociedade podem proporcionar.


Localidade: Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Cascavel/PR.



O que a Vértua oferece:

Contratação imediata com plano de carreira estruturado;

Curso preparatório para ANCORD totalmente custeado pela empresa;

Cultura de Meritocracia Radical (dobra salarial por performance);

Oportunidade realde Equity (Sociedade) baseada em resultados.


Como se candidatar:

Se você deseja transformar seu interesse pelo mercado financeiro em uma carreira de sócio em um dos escritórios que mais cresce na região, candidate-se agora!

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL


BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.


Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.


Why joining us?


Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.


Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.


Why do we want you?


We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.



Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:


1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders;
use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.


Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:


1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.


Competences:


a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.


Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.


Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

title: Payroll Analyst
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

This team is responsible for the ongoing coordination of payroll processing activities, including the collection and validation of payroll inputs, and the validation and controls of monthly payroll run outputs, with the overarching objective of processing salaries in a timely and accurate manner across the region. The team liaises continuously with multiple internal stakeholders (employees, HR and Finance colleagues) and the outsourced payroll services provider, providing expert advice on payroll-related topics.


Job Description

The Payroll Analyst is responsible for the complete, end-to-end management and execution of the payroll cycle for the Brazilian entity, ensuring flawless accuracy, strict legal compliance, and maximum process efficiency.

This professional will serve as the primary payroll and Personnel Administration (DP) subject matter expert (SME), closely collaborating with the Finance, Human Resources, and Occupational Health and Safety teams to ensure the accurate interpretation and application of all national labor laws and their financial implications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Payroll Operations: Manage and execute the full payroll lifecycle, including data entry, processing, advances, monthly closing, and managing all related bank transactions.
  • Compliance & Regulatory Reporting (DP Focus): Ensure absolute compliance with all local taxes, statutory obligations, and labor legislation (CLT). This includes managing specific government requirements such as eSocial, eConsignado, and other mandated regulatory reporting.
  • Financial Reconciliation: Lead the complex payroll general ledger account reconciliation process and coordinate the period closing activities with the Accounting and Finance teams.
  • Absence & Leave Management: Oversee and accurately process all employee events related to Personnel Administration (DP), including absences, sick leaves, medical leaves, and temporary contract suspensions and legally mandated leaves, ensuring adherence to company policy and legal requirements.
  • Policy & Audit Support: Review, develop, and update internal payroll and DP policies and procedures. Act as the key contact and support resource for both internal and external audits.
  • System Administration: Configure and maintain the payroll system (e.G., ADP) to reflect new rules, regulations, and benefit changes. Manage all payments to payroll-related third-party vendors.
  • Strategic Reporting: Develop and deliver insightful managerial reports and in-depth analyses of payroll processes to support business decision-making and forecasting.


Basic Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Accounting, or Human Resources Management, with a strong focus or specialization in Personnel Administration (Departamento Pessoal - DP).
  • Experience: Proven, extensive experience in end-to-end payroll processing and administration in a complex environment.
  • Legal Expertise: Deep knowledge and understanding of local Brazilian Labor Legislation (CLT) and associated union/collective bargaining obligations.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in payroll systems (e.G., ADP is highly preferred), Advanced Excel skills, and experience with Google Workspace/Tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to perform complex account reconciliation, proactively identify issues, and resolve discrepancies quickly and accurately.
  • Analytical Ability: Strong capacity to gather data, perform complex analysis, and develop clear, actionable managerial reports.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for effective interaction with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and auditors.
  • Language: Advanced English proficiency is required. Spanish proficiency is desirable.


EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Clinical Application Specialist
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with FibroScan® , the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.

FibroScan® is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.

Echosens has made FibroScan® available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.

Echosens is shaping the future of liver health . As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.

In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH ), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.


Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.


To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:


CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)

LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)


The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.


This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.



Main activities :


  • Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens FibroScan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
  • Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
  • Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
  • Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise


Experience / Education / Special Requirements



You have a bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.


You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.


Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.


You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.



Please submit your application and CV in English.



Why join ECHOSENS ?


  • Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
  • Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
  • Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.
  • Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation.
  • Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities.




ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. title: Gerente De Operações Financeiras
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.


Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.


Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Sobre a posição

O Gerente de Operações Financeiras atuará de forma estratégica na estruturação e execução de operações financeiras da companhia, com foco em emissões de dívida, gestão de caixa estratégico e relacionamento com investidores e instituições financeiras. A posição será peça-chave na estruturação do IPO da companhia, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento sustentável e o fortalecimento da governança financeira corporativa.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Estruturar e conduzir operações de equity, incluindo ações preferenciais privadas, e apoiar iniciativas de dívida (debêntures e bonds), assegurando equilíbrio da estrutura de capital.
  • Coordenar estratégias de captação com investidores, em parceria com Tesouraria, alinhadas ao crescimento e à eficiência do caixa corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com Jurídico, RI, Planejamento e Tesouraria, garantindo alinhamento técnico, regulatório e estratégico das operações.
  • Apoiar a agenda de funding, governança financeira e preparação para o IPO, assegurando compliance e aderência ao roadmap definido.
  • Gerir o relacionamento com bancos, investidores e assessores financeiros, participando de negociações e roadshows quando aplicável.
  • Liderar iniciativas para aumento de eficiência e performance das frentes de mercado de capitais.


Perfil desejado

  • Formação: Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
    pós-graduação ou MBA emFinanças será considerado diferencial.
  • Experiência consistente em mercado de capitais, com foco em operações de equity e estruturação financeira.
  • Vivência em instituições financeiras ou empresas com acesso recorrente ao mercado de capitais (equity, debêntures, IPOs).
  • Forte capacidade de relacionamento e articulação com áreas pares (Planejamento, Jurídico, RI, Tesouraria) e stakeholders externos.
  • Perfil proativo, técnico e relacional, capaz de conduzir agendas estratégicas com autonomia, mantendo alinhamento e fluidez na comunicação.
  • Desejável experiência anterior em estruturação de operações de ações preferenciais privadas e elaboração de acordos de acionistas.


Competências comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica e capacidade analítica apurada.
  • Comunicação assertiva e habilidade de influência.
  • Autonomia, organização e senso de dono.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente dinâmico, de relacionamento intenso e múltiplas interfaces.
  • Alta energia e engajamento com o negócio, valorizando a presença e colaboração presencial.


Modelo de trabalho

  • Presencial na Holding – São Paulo (Faria Lima). A posição requer disponibilidade integral para atuação presencial, dada a alta interação com a Diretoria Financeira, Jurídico, RI e demais áreas corporativas.

title: Analista Fiscal
description:
Sobre a Empresa

title: Gerente De Negócios Mid-Market (Hunter)
description:

REQUISITOS:

  • Inglês avançadoou fluente;
  • Experiência comcold calls;
  • Experiência comvendas complexas e ciclos de venda de pelo menos 3 meses para clientes Enterprise

O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é híbrido, sendo 3 dias de trabalho no escritório e 2 dias home-office.

title: It Site Support Manager
description:
Overview


The IT Site Support Manager is responsible for leading and developing the IT Site Support Team, delivering a high-quality end-user experience, and ensuring the effective application of ITIL best practices. This role plays a critical part in standardizing IT support operations, optimizing costs, and ensuring compliance with corporate IT and security standards.


The manager will collaborate closely with global IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, supporting enterprise initiatives and ensuring consistent, efficient, and secure IT support services across the site.


Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, coach, and manage the IT Site Support team to ensure individual and team performance expectations are consistently met.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support skills development and career growth.
  • Ensure adequate staffing, workload distribution, and coverage to meet business needs.


End-User Experience & Service Delivery

  • Drive continuous improvement of the end-user IT support experience.
  • Measure service satisfaction levels, analyze feedback, and implement improvement actions.
  • Manage and uphold the incident troubleshooting and escalation process to ensure timely and effective resolution.


ITIL, Process & Operational Excellence

  • Apply ITIL best practices across incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Identify gaps in IT support processes and implement enhancements to improve efficiency and service quality.
  • Work closely with the Service Desk team to ensure proper documentation, knowledge sharing, and user guidance related to incidents and requests.
  • Ensure all IT support activities are properly documented and records are maintained accurately.

Standardization, Cost & Vendor Management

  • Identify opportunities for standardization, operational efficiency, and cost reduction.
  • Develop and implement strategies to achieve measurable cost savings.
  • Review reports related to hardware, peripherals, malfunctions, maintenance, and productivity impact to address recurring issues.
  • Negotiate and manage contracts with vendors, consultants, and technical service providers.

Technology Implementation & Global Collaboration

  • Assist global IT teams with the remediation and implementation of new technologies, systems, and devices.
  • Support the adoption and enforcement of corporate standards for hardware, software, applications, and IT security.
  • Collaborate with regional and global IT stakeholders to align local support activities with enterprise initiatives.


Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure all IT support activities comply with company policies, procedures, and security guidelines.
  • Support audits, reporting, and management reviews as required.


Qualifications & Experience


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in IT support management or a similar leadership role.
  • Strong working knowledge of ITIL best practices .
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory , as this role regularly interacts with global teams, stakeholders, and vendors .
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven leadership and people management capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience planning and executing cost-reduction and process improvement initiatives.
  • Solid knowledge of corporate IT standards related to hardware, applications, and IT security.
  • Ability to independently manage responsibilities while effectively collaborating with global teams.


Nice to Have

  • Additional language skills , such as Spanish or Portuguese , are a plus and beneficial for collaboration with regional teams and local stakeholders.
  • ITIL certification or other relevant IT service management certifications.
  • Experience supporting multi-site or regional IT operations.

title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.


Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

  • Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.
  • Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.
  • Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.
  • Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.
  • Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.
  • Expected Results
  • Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.
  • Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.


Qualifications & Skills

  • Should be able to communicate in English
  • Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.
  • Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Líder Fertirrigação
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder Fertirrigação para atuar no nosso time Tratos Culturais .


Quais as responsabilidades?

- Liderar as atividades de aplicação de vinhaça e água residual com o auxílio de subordinados diretos e indiretos, buscando maximizar a capacidade dos equipamentos de utilização, garantir a uniformidade da aplicação, respeitar as normas ambientais de aplicação, cuidar para que haja um perfeito sincronismo entre a produção e o emprego da vinhaça e água residual;

- Liderar a conservação dos canais de distribuição de vinhaça em perfeitas condições de uso;

- Distribuir a quantidade de vinhaça a ser aplicada de acordo com a Recomendação Agronômica.

- Especificar o local de irrigação, transporte e aplicação, orientando a equipe, visando seguir o planejamento de irrigação do início de safra.

- Administrar equipe de trabalho, capacitando, avaliando e adequando o quadro de pessoal.


Quais os requisitos?

- Formação em técnico agrícola, engenharia agronômica ou áreas afins;

- Experiência em Tratos Culturais.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Inspetor(A) Manutenção Sênior
description:
Você fará parte de um time técnico estratégico, atuando como referência em manutenção preditiva , com foco em análise avançada de vibração e diagnóstico de máquinas rotativas . Sua atuação será essencial para garantir a confiabilidade dos ativos, apoiar tecnicamente a equipe e disseminar metodologias e boas práticas de análise.


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Realizar inspeções, executar e guiar instalações e manutenção mecânica, elétrica e instrumentação em máquinas e equipamentos de várias complexidades, interpretando manuais, desenhos e esboços, orientando os usuários em dúvida sobre a operação e os recursos.

- Inspecionar a instalação de máquinas e equipamentos de várias complexidades, de modo a avaliar as condições operacionais.

- Monitorar e rastrear atividades relacionadas ao campo de manutenção e guiar tecnicamente a equipe quando necessário.

- Verificar, monitorar e controlar o desgaste dos componentes do equipamento, propor melhorias através da verificação sistemática, usando ferramentas apropriadas e registrando as informações, com o objetivo de disponibilidade e aumentar a vida útil do equipamento.

- Leia e interprete desenhos e esboços para manutenção, localização de falhas e falhas do equipamento, usando ferramentas apropriadas de instrumentação e medição.

- Inspecionar as peças, ferramentas e suprimentos de manutenção no recibo do armazém, por meio de conhecimento técnico e ferramentas adequadas para garantir que o material atenda às especificações.

- Garantir a limpeza, a organização do local de trabalho e a manutenção de ferramentas e equipamentos, mantendo -os organizados e limpos para a reutilização, conforme necessário, atendendo às regras e procedimentos.

- Avaliar e implementar melhorias nos sistemas de inspeção, por meio de sugestões como estudos e inspeções.

- Emitir relatório técnico com diagnóstico e recomendações, destinado a apontar as anormalidades para o funcionamento adequado do equipamento e o aumento da vida útil do serviço.

- Atender Solicitações contidas nas ordens de serviço

- Executar planos de monitoramento de equipamentos, componentes ou itens por meio de instrumentação apropriada, como: imagem térmica, endoscopia, vibração e alinhamento, entre outros;

- Desenvolver o diagnóstico do tipo de relatórios de defeitos, e orientar a intervenção das áreas de especialização, quando necessário.

- Participar com a engenharia de manutenção, o desenvolvimento de relatórios de análise de falhas

- Garantir o uso adequado das ferramentas disponíveis, como câmera, computadores e equipamentos de análise sensível e preditivos

- Desenvolver relatórios de análise de vibração, fornecendo aconselhamento técnico para apoiar decisões e gerenciamento da equipe de manutenção

- Seguir as regras atendendo aos requisitos de sistemas de gestão da qualidade, padrões ambientais e de segurança de trabalho inerentes ao setor e ao uso de EPP / EPC (equipamento de proteção pessoal / equipamento de proteção coletiva) quando a atividade requer, para garantir o Integridade física dos funcionários.

- Identificar qualquer avaria em equipamentos, mesmo na inspeção sensitiva, abrir nota e comunicar imediatamente o setor responsável;

- Desenvolver outras atividades do escritório ou a critério de seu superior imediato, para atender às demandas e seu crescimento profissional

  • Formação técnica ou superior na área industrial/mecânica (ou correlata).
  • Conhecimento em equipamentos mecânicos , com foco em máquinas rotativas (nível médio a avançado).
  • Experiência comprovada em coleta e análise de vibração .
  • Certificação em Análise de Vibração – Nível 1 e 2 .


Vivência prática com:

  • Sistemas de análise de vibração.
  • Bancos de dados para análise de vibração.
  • Balanceamento de equipamentos .
  • MHM VMS (monitoramento e vibração) .
  • SAP .
  • Experiência em manutenção preditiva, inspeção técnica e/ou confiabilidade .

title: Engenheiro Da Qualidade De Fornecedores
description:

title: Domain Architect Operations Technology
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!



Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Domain Architect Operations Technology , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, Remote , in the city of Belo Horizonte.


Job Description:

The Domain Architect – Operation Technology is fundamental to the architecture, governance and evolution of operational technology solutions and infrastructures in the mining operations of Brasil and Canada. This professional will lead the integration of traditional OT systems (SCADA, DCS, PLCs) with emerging technologies of industrial IoT, industrial cloud, advanced automation and OT cybersecurity.

Its mission is to ensure safe, resilient, integrated industrial operations aligned with global digital strategy, supporting innovations in mining 4.0, sustainability, operational efficiency and digital transformation. He will work collaboratively with technical, security, IT and business areas at the multinational level.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and govern OT architectures , ensuring alignment between industrial systems, automation, IoT sensors and integration with IT and Cloud.
  • Design solutions for real-time control, monitoring, automation and analysis of industrial processes, ensuring high availability and resilience.
  • Lead modernization projects, edge/cloud OT integration, digital twins, predictive analytics, cognitive automation, and operational security.
  • Assess and implement global OT security standards (NIST, IEC 62443), vulnerability management, and industrial cyber incident response.
  • Foster alignment between OT and IT teams to promote secure, efficient, and scalable integration of operational technologies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, contingency plans, operational guides, and OT governance policies.
  • Participate in the definition of strategies for technological innovation, sustainability and reduction of environmental impact.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and strategic partners on critical OT solutions, ensuring system interoperability.
  • Train technical teams and promote a culture of safety and OT innovation in global operations.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Fluent English for global communication between Brazil-Canada work.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computing, Industrial Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, or operational technology leadership in industrial or mining sectors.
  • In-depth knowledge of OT systems: SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, IoT sensors, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, Profibus).
  • Expertise in OT/IT integration, edge computing architectures, digital twins, advanced automation, predictive analytics and Industrial Big Data.
  • Solid domain in OT cybersecurity, IEC 62443 frameworks, NIST, incident management and operational continuity.
  • Knowledge in industrial cloud platforms (Azure IoT, AWS IoT, Google Cloud Industrial) and OT modernization.
  • Experience with governance, regulatory compliance, sustainability and ESG standards in the mining and process industry.


Soft Skills

  • Technical and consultative leadership, negotiation skills and influence in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Strategic vision to connect OT technological innovation to business, safety and sustainability.
  • Clear and effective communication to diverse stakeholders and technical and executive teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, critical thinking and focus on sustainable and safe results.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Technical certifications in OT (ISA/IEC 62443, Certified Automation Professional, Cybersecurity Certifications).
  • Experience with industrial digital platforms, analytics, AI/ML applied to operation.
  • Experience in operations or in large-scale mining.
  • Ability to conduct global projects with multiple teams and stakeholders.



Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust architecture and governance of OT solutions, supporting Brazil and Canada operations with security and innovation.
  • Leadership in OT digital transformation projects aiming at sustainability, automation and operational efficiency.
  • Support OT/IT integration, compliance, and governance of critical operations.
  • Dissemination of OT governance and global technical capacity building.
  • Increased resilience, safety and efficiency of industrial operations.


Additional Comments:

The OT Domain Architect is a key player in the technological and sustainable evolution of industrial operations, working in complex and global environments. Technical expertise, strategic vision, and collaborative capabilities are essential to strengthen technological leadership in the mining and energy sectors.

description:
Resumo do Cargo


Reportando-as ao Supervisor de Controladoria, é responsável pela consolidação dos custos industriais, validação de KPI’s financeiros para Operações, incluindo consolidação, validação, análise e preparação de relatórios, garantindo a qualidade dos dados e desenvolvimento de ferramentas para suportar estas atividades.

Excel avançado;

Sobre a Ardagh:


A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)



Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Especialista Em Risco E Crédito
description:
Sobre nós

Kob é um meio de pagamento que nasceu com o propósito de transformar o mercado corporativo, ajudando as empresas a vender mais e sem risco de inadimplência.

Criada pela Kobold em 2023, a Kob Meios de Pagamento é parceira estratégica da Visa e leva para o segmento B2B a mesma agilidade, simplicidade e segurança já oferecida às pessoas físicas.

A expertise de risco acumulada pela Kobold em mais de 30 anos permite promover, no universo das empresas, a mesma transformação que o cartão de crédito trouxe para o mercado B2C algumas décadas atrás.

A Kob Meios de Pagamento tem uma abordagem inovadora porque oferece um meio de pagamento 100% digital diretamente às empresas vendedoras, com uma precificação que respeita a realidade de margens do mercado corporativo.

Se você é uma pessoa de perfil analítico, criativo, com uma forma de pensar diferente, possui capacidade de organização, e busca por um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e de muito aprendizado, venha conhecer a nossa vaga de Especialista em Riscos de Crédito.

Nós valorizamos o trabalho em equipe e apoiamos o desenvolvimento profissional de todos os tipos de perfis.


Nossos valores

  • Juntos: Caminhar em sintonia, somando ideias e criando parcerias.
  • Flexíveis: Ter a humildade de reconhecer valor em novas capacidades e mudar.
  • Transparentes: Demonstrar clareza de intenções e ter consistência nas ações.
  • Inquietos: Ter a atitude de questionar e reaprender continuamente (aprofundar-se).
  • Um passo à frente: Estar em constante evolução, com coragem perante os desafios (iniciativa).
  • Eficientes: Ampliar o alcance e reduzir o desperdício.


Você irá

  • Realizar análises referente a levantamentos de dados econômico-financeiros de clientes para definição de limites de crédito.
  • Elaborar relatórios de avaliação de risco de crédito e consulta a eventuais restrições.
  • Construir, otimizar e garantir a eficácia dos processos de risco de crédito B2B.
  • Colaborar na manutenção das políticas e procedimentos para a área, garantindo o alinhamento com as melhores práticas do setor.
  • Realizar estudos e análises de indicadores para apontar eventuais ajustes que se façam necessários nas políticas vigentes.
  • Acompanhar as performances das carteiras e monitorar as exposições de crédito ativas.
  • Ter habilidade para se comunicar de forma precisa e pontual a respeito das questões de risco de crédito e das sugestões de medidas de mitigação possíveis de serem adotadas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com demais times internos, identificando oportunidades de melhorias operacionais e/ou potenciais riscos.
  • Participar dos Comitês de Crédito e contribuir na tomada de decisões de risco.


Requisitos e experiência prévia

  • Experiência com risco de crédito B2B.
  • Formação, preferencialmente em áreas exatas: Engenharias, Economia e Finanças.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificação de problemas e proposição de soluções otimizadas.
  • Conhecimento de crédito para B2B.
  • Ter experiência em definição de processos operacionais de risco de crédito, elaboração de relatórios e apresentações executivas.


Soft Skills

  • Pensar de maneira questionadora focando na solução de problemas de forma efetiva.
  • Capacidade de entender riscos dos setores de atuação dos nossos clientes e seus cenários macroeconômicos.
  • Questionar informações financeiras dos clientes, bem como suas inconsistências.
  • Ser capaz de comunicar ideias simples e complexas de forma clara, objetiva e eficaz. Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, é imprescindível.
  • Desenvoltura, responsabilidade e comprometimento com o time.
  • Habilidade (e humildade) para aprender - desaprender - reaprender.
  • Facilidade em se relacionar e criar pontes entre áreas, fazendo os alinhamentos necessários.
  • Entender o contexto real dos nossos clientes e buscar alternativas viáveis para ambos os lados, sem maximizar o risco.
  • Elaborar pareceres de risco de crédito e sustentar argumentos técnicos em comitês
  • Sentir-se confortável de trabalhar com autonomia e de forma auto gerenciada.
  • Flexibilidade e facilidade de adaptação.


Diferenciais

  • Nível avançado em Excel e Google Workspace.
  • Vivência na construção de parâmetros de motores de crédito
  • Experiências anteriores na área de crédito de Indústrias nacionais e/ou multinacionais


O que oferecemos

Formato de trabalho: Trabalhamos no modelo híbrido, com idas ao escritório, pelo menos, 2x/semana.
